fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received at least 2 cycles and maximum of 6 cycles of front-line platinum-based chemotherapy with ICI-based therapy, regardless of PD-L1 expression.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior treatment specifies cycle counts rather than prior line counts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Reached first disease progression by radiological assessment while receiving front-line or maintenance ICI.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Disease progression status is a clinical assessment event rather than a typed biomarker or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable target tumor lesion anywhere except the brain per RECIST 1.1 by Computed Tomography (CT) or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scan.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have adequate renal, hepatic, bone marrow function as well as adequate coagulation tests [International Normalized Ratio (INR)] and adequate immune function by lymphocyte count.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ function lacks explicit numeric laboratory cutoffs in the source text.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Be willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, the treatment plan, imaging and laboratory tests.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to comply is a subjective criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastasis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease is not a clean typed brain_mets status of none, treated_stable, or untreated.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any uncontrolled systemic disease, condition or comorbidity that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would interfere with evaluation of study treatment or interpretation of patient safety or study results.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Be willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, the treatment plan, imaging and laboratory tests.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active and untreated urinary tract infection, pneumonia, or other systemic infections.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Infection status is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastasis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease is not a clean typed brain_mets status of none, treated_stable, or untreated.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any uncontrolled systemic disease, condition or comorbidity that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would interfere with evaluation of study treatment or interpretation of patient safety or study results.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion-based exclusions are fuzzy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Persistent toxicities [Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade ≥ 3] caused by previous anticancer therapy; alopecia and vitiligo are excluded toxicities.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unresolved prior toxicity grade is not a standard typed lab or therapy exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Required the use of additional immunosuppression other than corticosteroids for the management of an adverse event or have experienced recurrence of an adverse event if re-challenged, or currently require maintenance doses of >10 mg prednisone or equivalent per day.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Corticosteroid and immunosuppressive medication rules are not standard typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Receiving concurrent antiviral agent active against vaccinia virus (e.g., cidofovir, vaccinia immunoglobulin, imatinib, tecovirimat, or other agents with known anti-vaccinia activities).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent medication restrictions for antiviral agents are not standard typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Underwent major surgery within 4 weeks, or have insufficient recovery from surgical-related trauma or wound healing, prior to the planned first dose of treatment in either Arm.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for major surgery is not a standard typed laboratory check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Vaccination against smallpox or monkeypox within 1 year of study therapy. Any non-oncology vaccine therapy used for prevention of infectious diseases, such as seasonal (influenza) vaccinations, corona virus disease (COVID) vaccination or other vaccines, within 2 weeks of the planned first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Vaccine history restrictions are not standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant skin disease as assessed by the Investigator (e.g., severe eczema, psoriasis, or any unresolved skin injury or ulcer).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Skin disease assessment by the investigator is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known hypersensitivity to carboplatin, cisplatin, paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel, docetaxel, or any of the constituents of Olvi-Vec (i.e., gentamicin). Had severe hypersensitivity (CTCAE Grade ≥ 3) to ICI and/or any of its excipients previously.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity to specific multiple drugs is not a simple prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Dementia or altered mental status that would prohibit informed consent, and/or psychiatric illness/social situations that might interfere or limit compliance with study requirements.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cognitive and psychiatric status limitations are subjective judgments.
